# netbox_power_ports (Data Source)

Lists NetBox power port objects (`/api/dcim/power-ports/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_power_ports" "all" {}

data "netbox_power_ports" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "power_ports_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_power_ports.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/power-ports/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `allocated_draw` (Number) Allocated power draw (watts). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `cable_end` (String) Cable End.
- `cable_id` (Number) Cable. References `netbox_cable`.
- `connected_endpoints_reachable` (Boolean) Connected Endpoints Reachable.
- `connected_endpoints_type` (String) Connected Endpoints Type.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `device_id` (Number) ID of the Device (`netbox_device`).
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to an empty string.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `link_peers_type` (String) Return the type of the peer link terminations, or None.
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat as if a cable is connected. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `maximum_draw` (Number) Maximum power draw (watts). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `module_id` (Number) ID of the Module (`netbox_module`).
- `name` (String) Name.
- `occupied` (Boolean) Occupied.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `type` (String) Physical port type. One of 106 valid NetBox choices (see the NetBox documentation). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `url` (String) Url.
